notes.title: The view is the public destination.
bullets: Public areas meet the curved glazing.
Four internal suites around a spine.
No stray pockets between the rooms.
A separate public promenade runs right.
journeys: Public guests continue to the windows.
Patients turn into the clinical cluster.

notes.title: The view is a shared amenity.
bullets: Discovery and salons occupy the left.
Right arrival serves the suite cluster.
Shared lounge follows the full curve.
No inset strip behind the lounge.

Patients use the right clinical spine.
Both connect to the window lounge.
concern: Hosted public access and private care
still need an agreed operating threshold.

notes.title: Two wings with shared arrival.
bullets: Café and window suites meet the glazing.
Their dividing wall reaches the shell.
A continuous arrival hall links the doors.
Public and care hosts sit at either end.
Assessment rooms line the right flank.
concern: the tightest part of this option.

notes.title: Two houses, not isolated rooms.
bullets: Each suite pair has a defined corridor,
Café reaches the curved window line.
